description: What a call context gives the envelope: the correlation context of the event (REQ-LOG-005). Only the four correlation ids go to the envelope context; the application and the instance of the call context are not part of it (the resource comes from the configuration); a call context with none of the four gives no context at all. expected is the exact canonical JSON of the context or null when there is none.

cases.description: all four ids and the identity
the application and the instance are not part of the envelope context
empty texts count as not set
